scope: Independent Gurobi MPS source reader; practical loader comparison, no solving

timing_contract.gurobi: gurobipy.read only, including source gzip decompression and vendor model construction
timing_contract.gurobi_separate: Environment startup, attribute extraction/comparison and OptBin reference loading excluded from read timer/RSS
timing_contract.binary: Native complete validated numerical arrays; no Gurobi model construction
timing_contract.gzip: Outer binary gzip expansion to a seekable temporary included
timing_contract.cache: Warm files; one verification/warmup per format, then shuffled fresh-process rounds

limitations: Different public API endpoints: Gurobi solver model versus validated binary numerical arrays
No optimization, presolve, GPU upload or compressed-file creation in read timings
Peak RSS is sampled before reference extraction/loading; filesystem cache and temporary disk excluded
Large comparison is LP-only; small LP/QP/QCQP may use the separate Python polynomial comparator
Gurobi infinity sentinels, zero signs and explicit sparse zeros are normalized; no numerical tolerance

python_source_validation.scope: Full numerical LP/QP/QCQP polynomial comparison outside all read timers
